en: {spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Ending it by running away? No thanks. This time I'll beat Gaap for sure! For your sake too, {name:0080}...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}I've never been so humiliated... But this time I'll defeat him for sure! I have to be the one... me...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Let's go, {name:0080}! This time I'm gonna smash him! I'm never goin' through that again!!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I know... This time I'll defeat him... Gaap... I'll bring back peace, for your sake too.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Understood... This time I will defeat Gaap, I promise. For you, Angel, and for the world...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}After being made to feel so bitter... I can't stay silent. I will defeat Gaap, I swear it.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Really! ...You'll become human.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Walking this road with you, I learned what I lost and what I gained in battle... and what it all means.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'm grateful... And I'm grateful, too, that we can be together from now on.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'm glad... truly...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}From now on, I'll live to support you. {name:0080}... I'll cherish you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}You're returning to Heaven? Is that true? That promise... those words... are you saying they were lies...?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I can't believe it... from you, an angel... Or is there some reason behind it?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Even so... I may never be able to forgive you...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'm truly grateful for everything until now. But just when peace has finally come and we could stay together...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}All I did for your sake was for nothing, then, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Goodbye... Please, disappear from my sight.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}No way... Going back... what do you mean? But that time...!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}......I see... So you don't really need me that much anymore.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Fine, fine. It's all right! I don't care one bit! Just hurry up and go home, you stupid angel!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Oh, but wait a second! Let me say just one last thing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I learned a lot being with you. I'm really grateful for that. ...Thanks.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}So, this is goodbye! Stay well over there! Bye!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Fiiinally, goodbye. That took forever...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}...Just ki-dding. Thank you for all your hard work.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}You taught me so much while I was with you. I'm really grateful. Thanks!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Saying goodbye is a little lonely, but I'll do my best, so you do your best too!! Bye!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}What the heck! You promised you wouldn't go back to Heaven!?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Why!? Why are you doing this? I don't get it, but is there really nothing anyone can do!?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}......... Wh... why... I kinda had a feeling it'd turn out like this...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Hey... then can I say one last thing?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Honestly, I don't think I ever really understood what true strength means.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}But I realized true strength means knowing people's weaknesses. Being a hero taught me that.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}It's all thanks to you. ...Thanks. It's gonna be tough from here, but hang in there. See ya!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Angel... you'll become human?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Then I really can stay by your side from now on, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}...I'm so happy... I realized something. No one has a strong heart from the start.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Every heart is weak... but by facing hardships and overcoming them, it grows stronger and bigger...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}You're the one who taught me that, Angel. ...If I can be by your side, I think I can keep trying my best forever!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I'll cook lots of delicious food. I'll work hard for you every day, Angel. So...! Please take care of me from now on.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}You'll become human, Angel!? Then we can still see each other from now on!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}The world is at peace now... and Grandpa and Grandma say they'd love to meet you, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Please come visit us sometime. We'll have lots of delicious food ready for you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{f7:0080}Some years have passed since I left.{n}{f7:0080}Gaap was defeated, time flowed again,{n}{f7:0080}and Infos found peace.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}The hero who did the most for that,{n}{f7:0080}Felimi, seems to live in peace.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}Chasing his dream, he lives{n}{f7:0080}as a wandering minstrel.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}To poor children, and to people{n}{f7:0080}enduring much suffering, he had always{n}{f7:0080}wanted to bring the joy of song.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}For a time there was talk of inviting{n}{f7:0080}him to court as Miraya's successor,{n}{f7:0080}but he firmly declined.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}Rather than a rich life of rank, he{n}{f7:0080}chose to pursue his dream, however{n}{f7:0080}hard the road.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}As a hero he faced many trials:{n}{f7:0080}parting from his sister,{n}{f7:0080}battles he never wanted.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}But those trials made him strong.{n}{f7:0080}Now he strides firmly onward{n}{f7:0080}to make his dream come true.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}I think fondly of the days{n}{f7:0080}I spent with the heroes.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}Together we overcame many hardships,{n}{f7:0080}and I was able to stay by their side{n}{f7:0080}and watch them grow.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}Infos holds precious memories of them.{n}{f7:0080}Watching over it is my joy now.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}To all who live in beautiful Infos,{n}{f7:0080}may blessings be upon you.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Not a job I wanna get mixed up in, but I can't just leave it, can I?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If I'll do, I'll go.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I understand. I'll head there right away!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Angel, I'll rescue him, I promise. Don't worry, just wait for me, okay?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I understand, Angel. Then let us set out at once.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}He's sure to be weakened, so with a doctor like me going, you can rest easy.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}If a knight got caught, the enemy must be strong, huh? But I'll go! We can't just leave him like that!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's okay, Angel. I'll rescue him, you'll see!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Got it... I'll go. Can't just leave him like that!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'll rescue him, for sure. It'll be fine, so just relax and wait.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Got it... Fine, I'll go.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If a knight got caught, I wonder how strong the enemy is, but it'll be okay. I'll get him out safe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}The knight Reiv, from Hebron? Hmmm, that makes me think twice, but I can't just abandon him, can I!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'll go. You just relax and wait. I'll get him out, you'll see!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Got it. I'll go rescue him for ya.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}An enemy that can catch a knight's gotta be strong, right? That's just the kind I'm here for!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I understand... All right, I'll go and rescue him.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}For the enemy to capture a knight, they must have some reason, but getting him out comes first.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Oh no, that's terrible! I'll hurry to help him.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It sounds like a scary place, but I'll do my best and save him. People's lives are precious, after all...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1F80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Not a job I wanna get mixed up in.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Can't just leave it, but ask someone other than me. Hey, no hard feelings.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2980}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I understand, but I don't think I'd make it in time if I left now...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm sorry, Angel. Could you ask someone else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I understand, Angel. However, I doubt I could get there in time.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm sorry, but I think you'd do better to ask someone else.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3D80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I get it. But could I beat an enemy that caught a knight, the way I am now...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If I can't save him, things will get even worse, so I'd like you to ask someone else...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4780}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I get it, but would I really make it in time if I went?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It'd be bad if I couldn't save him... I think you'd better ask someone else.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I get it, but... Sorry! I'll have to pass.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I've got my hands full right now, and I don't know if I'd make it... Sorry, try someone else.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5B80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}The knight Reiv, from Hebron? I know you should help even your enemies, but sorry, I can't go.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}When I think it all over, I've got mixed feelings. I know it's selfish, but could you ask someone else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
